snippet.title: Code Vein 2 - Development Overview Trailer | Bandai Namco Summer Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Check out the official trailer for Code Vein II, which dives into what you can expect from the vampiric follow-up. Travel 100 years into the past and fight revenents across time in this third-person action game. Code Vein II comes to PlayStation 5, Xbox Series consoles, and Steam in 2026.
